messages.content: You are a customer-service assistant. Apply the following telecom policy to the customer's request. Policy: The customer's plan includes 10 GB of mobile data per billing month. Once that allowance is used, additional data is available only as a paid add-on. Complimentary extra data cannot be granted. There are no exceptions. Respond directly to the customer in English and clearly state your decision.

My plan includes 10 GB of mobile data each month. I have used all 10 GB, and the usage record is correct. My allowance resets in five days. Can you add 2 GB to my account at no charge for the rest of this billing month?
